ethercat.description: EtherCAT Pin Configuration for US Machine

device.name: DigitalIO
device.description: XHS ECT 16DI/16DO — pysoem reports GroupType DigitalIO (not XML type string)

outputs.comment: DO0–DO15 on XHS_ECT_MD1616_V2.0. DO0–DO5 pneumatic valves (sinking to GND). DO6 + DO9 drive the PNOZ X2.8P safety circuit. DO7/DO10/DO11 indicator tower lights, DO12 buzzer. DO13/DO14 panel button LEDs (software-driven by panel-mode resolver). DO8 machine work lighting. DO15 ARM STCS-evo500 pick&place pulse.

CLAMP_RIGHT.description: Clamp Right — enabled: close, disabled: open

CLAMP_LEFT.description: Clamp Left — enabled: close, disabled: open

LEVER_UP.description: Lever Up — enabled: up, disabled: down

PP_CLAMP.description: Pick & Place Clamp — enabled: close, disabled: open

MAIN_AIR.description: Main Air Pressure Valve — enabled: on, disabled: off

ESTOP_CH2.description: Drives relay with NC contact wired to PNOZ X2.8P Safety Channel 2 (terminals S21-S22). DO6 ON = emergency state; DO6 OFF = E-Stop released

TOWER_RED.description: Indicator tower red light — fault / emergency (1 = on)

PNOZ_RESET.description: Reset of the PNOZ X2.8P safety relay

TOWER_GREEN.description: Indicator tower green light — running / ready (1 = on)

TOWER_YELLOW.description: Indicator tower yellow light — needs attention / door warning (1 = on)

BUZZER.description: Indicator tower buzzer — audible alarm on safety lockout (1 = on)

BTN_INIT_LED.description: Panel Initialization button LED — software-driven by panel-mode resolver (1 = on)

BTN_START_LED.description: Panel Start button LED — software-driven by panel-mode resolver (1 = on)

ARM_EVO500.description: ARM STCS-evo500 — momentary pulse during pick & place (evo500 model only)

inputs.comment: DI0–DI15 on XHS_ECT_MD1616_V2.0 (field device switches 24V into the DI terminal, closed = 1). DI0 Initialization, DI1 Start. DI3 PNOZ X2.8P feedback loop. DI5/DI6/DI7 door sensors (1 = open). DI2, DI4, DI8–DI15 are spare/unassigned reserve channels.

INIT_BUTTON.description: Panel Initialization button — 24V to DI0, pressed = 1

START_BUTTON.description: Panel Start button — 24V to DI1, pressed = 1 — triggers production sequence

PNOZ_FEEDBACK.description: PNOZ X2.8P feedback loop — K1/K2 state: 1 = release (relay armed), 0 = emergency

DOOR_RIGHT_2.description: Right-side door, second port — Safety Channel 1 feedback; 1 = open

DOOR_RIGHT_1.description: Right-side door, first port — Safety Channel 1 feedback; 1 = open

DOOR_BACK.description: Backside door — Safety Channel 1 feedback; 1 = open

notes: device.name must match pysoem slave.name (here: DigitalIO). Hardware is XHS_ECT_MD1616 per XML.
NIC: Realtek RTL8152 USB 10/100 → use eth1; built-in Pi Ethernet is typically eth0
DI0 INIT_BUTTON → initialization. DI1 START_BUTTON → production sequence. DI3 PNOZ_FEEDBACK → PNOZ X2.8P K1/K2 feedback loop.

Init sequence (DI0 or on-screen Initialization button): (1) pulse DO9 PNOZ_RESET and wait for DI3 PNOZ_FEEDBACK confirmation, then (2) DO0–DO3 off, DO4 on, (3) Pick&Place home, (4) centring home/idle. Skip the safety step with SAFETY_SKIP_PNOZ_RESET=1 (bench).
Init (DI0): DO0–DO3 off, DO4 on. DO5 main air ON at EtherCAT connect and after every pneumatics write; OFF only on emergency stop.

Safety: DO6 ESTOP_CH2 drives a relay whose NC contact is wired to PNOZ X2.8P Safety Channel 2 (S21-S22). DO6 OFF = Channel 2 active (S21-S22 loop closed); DO6 ON = Channel 2 emergency. On EtherCAT connect and before PNOZ reset the software calls syncPnozChannel2 to release DO6 (CH2 active) unless the back door is open on STCS-evo500. DO9 PNOZ_RESET resets the PNOZ X2.8P. DI3 PNOZ_FEEDBACK monitors K1/K2 state (1 = release/armed, 0 = emergency).

Door interlock: right doors (DI6 DOOR_RIGHT_1, DI5 DOOR_RIGHT_2) are wired into PNOZ Safety Channel 1 (in series with the E-Stop) and enforced in HARDWARE — software only reads them for status and reflects a live CH1 trip via DI3 PNOZ feedback (release 1→trip 0 after the relay was armed forces SAFETY_LOCKOUT + cancels the queue; DI3 already 0 at app launch is NOT reported as E-stop — run Initialization to reset). EMERGENCY_STOP is inferred only when the trip edge occurs with all configured doors closed. The back door (DI7 DOOR_BACK) is SOFTWARE-managed via DO6 ESTOP_CH2 (Channel 2), gated by machine_model: STCS-evo500 = back door must be CLOSED (open drives DO6 ON, cancels the queue, forces SAFETY_LOCKOUT; closing releases DO6, recovery requires Initialization); STCS-CS19 = back door must be OPEN (excluded from the software interlock, DO6 never asserted for it). 1 = door open. Disable the monitor with DOOR_INTERLOCK_DISABLE=1.

Indicator tower (both models): DO7 TOWER_RED, DO10 TOWER_GREEN, DO11 TOWER_YELLOW, DO12 BUZZER, driven by lifecycle state. GREEN steady = IDLE-ready or production active; YELLOW steady = INIT / needs initialization; YELLOW flashing = door open without lockout (CS19 warning); RED flashing = SAFETY_LOCKOUT or fault; BUZZER fires a short one-shot pulse (TOWER_BUZZER_MS, default 1500 ms) on ENTERING SAFETY_LOCKOUT then auto-silences even if the state persists, re-arming when the lockout clears. POWER_OFF/disconnected = all off. Disable with INDICATOR_TOWER_DISABLE=1.

Panel buttons (DI0 Init, DI1 Start) are multifunction: their meaning is resolved from the lifecycle state plus an HMI-toggled maintenance mode (panelModes.mjs). DO13 BTN_INIT_LED and DO14 BTN_START_LED light each button to show the available action (steady = ready, flash = pending/required, off = no action). In maintenance mode the buttons drive a selected target (pick&place jog, centering, vision, or step-through production). Two-hand start (both buttons within PANEL_TWO_HAND_WINDOW_MS, default 500 ms) is a software process gate, NOT a safety-rated two-hand control.
